name: Owl The
overview: Scripture identifies the owl as a solitary and mournful creature that inhabits deserted places, as reflected in Psalms 102:6 where the psalmist likens himself to an owl of the desert. The owl is also described with care for its young and is illustrative of mourners. Leviticus 11 and Deuteronomy 14 list various types of owls among unclean birds that are not to be eaten, emphasizing their symbolic role in biblical teaching about purity and desolation.
